vi: Thay thế long-lived AWS access key bằng OIDC federation: GitHub Actions issue JWT, AWS verify signature via public key của GitHub, STS phát hành credential ngắn hạn
Thiết kế trust policy với `StringEquals` condition trên `aud` (audience) và `sub` (subject) — pin cả hai để ngăn repo/branch lạ assume role
Tạo OIDC provider bằng Terraform `aws_iam_openid_connect_provider`, tách riêng trust policy (ai được vào) và permission policy (vào rồi làm gì)
Áp dụng OIDC federation cho IRSA (IAM Role for Service Account): Pod EKS assume role qua projected ServiceAccount token, mỗi Pod một danh tính riêng thay vì share node role
Audit OIDC assume trail qua CloudTrail: mỗi `sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity` ghi rõ JWT claim (`aud`/`sub`), kiểm soát được audit chain từ workflow tới AWS API
en: Replace long-lived AWS access keys with OIDC federation: GitHub Actions issues a JWT, AWS verifies the signature using GitHub's public key, STS issues short-lived credentials
Design trust policies with StringEquals conditions on aud (audience) and sub (subject) — pin both to prevent foreign repos and branches from assuming the role
Create an OIDC provider using Terraform aws_iam_openid_connect_provider, keeping trust policy (who may assume) separate from permission policy (what they can do)
Apply OIDC federation for IRSA (IAM Role for Service Account): EKS Pods assume a role via projected ServiceAccount token, each Pod gets its own identity instead of sharing the node role
Audit the OIDC assumption trail via CloudTrail: each sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity logs the JWT claims (aud/sub), creating a full audit chain from workflow to AWS API
